Subject: Interested — Dedicated capacity demo and throughput questions

Hi Diego,

We just completed a self-serve trial on Redwood and saw good initial latency numbers. I'm running ML Ops at Nebula and want to explore a Dedicated deployment to meet our production SLA. A couple quick details:
- Workload: conversational assistant, average request size ~300 tokens, peak spikes up to 800 tokens.
- Traffic profile: sustained ~120 RPS during business hours, short spikes to ~350 RPS for 3-5 minutes.
- Target: p95 generation latency <200ms for 512-token responses, deterministic tail behavior.

Can we schedule a short technical demo to confirm capacity fit and fallback policies? Alex (cc'd) is our infra lead and will join. We're in PST. Best windows: Tue/Wed mornings PST.

Thanks,
Sara Nguyen
Head of ML Ops
Nebula Analytics

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>

Hi Sara — thanks for the details and for trying the self-serve flow. This is exactly the sort of profile where Dedicated makes sense. Quick notes up front:
- Sustained 120 RPS with 350 RPS spikes lines up to a reserved pool + burst configuration; we often recommend a burst buffer and autoscale policy for those 3-5 minute spikes.
- p95 <200ms for ~512 tokens is aggressive but feasible depending on model family and quantization. We'll validate on the demo.

Proposed next steps:
1) 30-minute technical walkthrough with one of our Solutions Engineers (Ben CC'd) to validate request patterns and show a capacity plan.
2) Share our Dedicated capacity checklist and a short mutual action plan ahead of the call (attached).

I have these PST slots open: Tue 2026-06-16 09:00-09:30, Wed 2026-06-17 09:30-10:00, Wed 2026-06-17 11:00-11:30. If none work, share alternatives and I'll loop in Ben to align on sizing.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-demos/30min (feel free to pick a slot)

Diego Fernandez
SDR, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1-415-555-0148

Attachments: dedicated-capacity-checklist.pdf (attached), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (attached)
